sources.title: Qwen2.5 72B Instruct - Open Source AI Models
sources.snippet: The flagship Qwen 2.5 release. Competes with Llama 3.1 405B on many benchmarks at one-fifth the parameter count. Note the 72B specifically uses the Qwen License (commercial use up to 100M MAU) — the smaller Qwen2.5 sizes are Apache 2.0.
